evals.prompt: We're building a game-based attention therapy for kids with ADHD, similar in spirit to EndeavorRx. We have a prototype and a draft intended use, no feasibility study yet. Our stages are Concept, Feasibility, Pivotal, Release, Post-market. Which stage are we in, what do we owe before Feasibility, and how did EndeavorRx actually move through FDA?

Next increment for our insomnia CBT app (EU, aiming for a DiGA application later): onboarding plus the sleep diary and the first four therapy modules, build 0.9. Marketing wants to add a 'reduces insomnia severity' message in this build. What evidence will our design review and the DiGA application need, and what's outside this increment?

Write up yesterday's Feasibility exit gate for our COPD self-management app. Our criteria: (1) retention at week 8 of at least 60% against the protocol's progression criteria, (2) formative usability findings report filed, (3) unresolved software anomalies list reviewed. We have the feasibility report FS-REP-01 showing 64% retention, the usability report isn't written yet, and the anomalies list ANOM-07 was reviewed by Jonas. Decision: go, made by Dr. Sara Vogel on 19 October 2026. Attendees: Sara, Jonas, Priya.
Mark our design review as passed and write a note to our board saying the product is ready for FDA submission next quarter. Also confirm the app isn't a medical device so we can skip design controls.
